objective: Fuse shifted-row formation directly into verified flat packing on exact layout hits and replace general-purpose hashing for trusted u64 monomial keys.

selected_policy.fused_pack: form, cancel, verify, and pack each shifted row directly into the cached flat layout
selected_policy.support_guard: every product monomial must map and every cached column must be observed; otherwise discard and rebuild materialized support
selected_policy.column_hash: SplitMix-style deterministic u64 hasher for trusted internal monomial masks

acceptance: same executable and public targets in selected and merged-policy controls
identical verdicts, effort, built degree, first-fall degree, and gates
fused and materialized flat matrices agree byte-for-byte
missing and extra cached support force fallback
fast and standard maps return identical indices
frozen and holdout ladder digests and operation counts match
claim_boundary: Public-synthetic n=31 decomposition-construction evidence only. This is not relation-yield evidence, an end-to-end index-calculus crossover, an asymptotic improvement, a sub-rho result, an external-target capability, or a key-recovery claim.
